decisions.reason: As a recent sensor module close to the core modular platform, it likely carries enough development investment and strategic fit that management would keep it and attribute any weak early uptake to normal ramp-up effects.

Because this industrial input module builds directly on the established offer and was given its own webpage, the firm has made a more visible commitment and is therefore especially likely to continue it.

This relay module fits the firm's existing automation building-block system, so with recent launch timing and sunk development effort management would be inclined to persist rather than withdraw it quickly.

Although this monitoring kit is somewhat more solution-specific than a standard module, it still extends the firm's established platform and a growing, investing firm would usually keep it on the market for longer before conceding failure.
